prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that you parallel-parked a full-size pickup on the first attempt and were observed being proud about it. Respond to the committee.
response:
**Mr. Chairman, members of the Committee:**

I am here today not to plead, but to state plainly and without shame what I did.

Yes. On or about last Thursday, in the parking lot adjacent to the Piggly Wiggly, I did, in full view of at least three witnesses and a shopping-cart boy, parallel-park a full-size, long-bed pickup truck on the very first attempt. I cut the wheel, eased it in, straightened up, and was approximately eight inches from the curb with the tailgate still clearing the car behind me. It was, by any reasonable standard, a thing of beauty.

And yes—God help me—I was proud of it.

I did not hide my satisfaction. I may have, in fact, allowed myself a small fist pump and muttered the words “still got it” before killing the engine. These acts were committed openly and without regret. I stand by them.

I would further like to submit for the record that the truck in question had oversized mirrors, a slight lift, and a trailer hitch the diameter of a soup can. Under those conditions, parallel parking on the first try is not merely skillful driving. It is, in the eyes of certain men, basically art.

If that makes me un-American, then fry me up some bacon and call me a communist, because I refuse to feel bad about it.

I am ready for your questions, gentlemen. But I warn you: I will not apologize for superior spatial awareness.
